sections.body: Let each player introduce who they are playing.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Script: Run one player at a time. Keep each intro around 30 seconds unless the table is intentionally using guided mode. Capture useful intro notes.
If a player freezes, ask only name, vibe, and why they took the job.
Do not pressure character performance before play has warmed up.
Checklist: Every player had a chance to introduce or pass; Character intro notes captured if useful
